metaData.title: Cheng Lesong's Speech Went Viral
metaData.oneSentenceSummary: Cheng Lesong, head of Peking University's Philosophy Department, opened his commencement address with self-deprecating humor and went on to deeply articulate the value of philosophy as a quality inspector of thought and a cleanser of ideas, urging graduates to maintain a balance between reflective awareness and restraint in an age of anxiety and to live an authentic life.
metaData.summary: This is the full text of the 2026 commencement address delivered by Cheng Lesong, head of the Philosophy Department at Peking University. The speech opens with a self-deprecating take on the 'involution' of graduation speeches and the anxiety of 'preachy chicken soup,' before pivoting to a serious exploration of the nature of philosophy. Cheng Lesong argues that philosophy serves as a quality inspector of thought and a cleanser of ideas, and that its core lies in subjecting the very questions that trouble our minds to careful and critical scrutiny. He criticizes the contemporary tendency toward self-deception through faulty ways of questioning — such as submitting emotional matters to rational judgment — and emphasizes that reflective awareness and critical capacity are the gifts philosophy offers. The article delves into modern symptoms such as the confusion between information overload and sensory overload, the hollowing out of value caused by the inflation of meaning, and the mental fragility born of excessive reflection. He pushes back against the posture of 'seeing through everything' and advocates for a measured balance between conviction and doubt. In closing, he addresses the graduates: life is a lush valley, a rough terrain — march forward resolutely amid the clamor of voices and live out a genuine argument.

mainPoints.point: The value of philosophy lies in serving as a quality inspector of thought, placing the questions themselves under careful scrutiny.
mainPoints.explanation: Cheng Lesong believes that the task of philosophy is to examine the ways we frame questions and deploy concepts, guarding against the corruption of language and self-deception caused by conceptual misplacement and logical confusion.

mainPoints.point: Most confusion stems from faulty ways of questioning; one must return to genuine feeling and self-knowledge.
mainPoints.explanation: People often mistake 'what I like' for a rational question, overlooking the desires and calculations behind it; only 'reflective sincerity' — grounded in lived experience and aimed at self-understanding — can reach the essence of life.

mainPoints.point: In an age of meaning inflation, excessive reflection leads instead to mental fragility and inaction.
mainPoints.explanation: The confusion between information overload and sensory overload, anxiety about social competition, and the fear of failure cause people to indulge in the promise of 'starting to truly live,' forgetting that they are already living.

mainPoints.point: A mature intellectual life requires maintaining a balance between conviction and doubt.
mainPoints.explanation: Both a closed self-consistency and a hasty self-negation are equally dangerous; philosophical clarity is a self-demand for sustained, active reflection, not a demand imposed on the world or on others.

mainPoints.point: Life is not a smooth experience checklist, but a journey that accommodates chaos and surprise and demands self-argumentation.
mainPoints.explanation: Whether life is worth living is not a judgment to be outsourced to others, but an argument each person must complete through living itself; let everything happen, and move forward with resolve.

keyQuotes: Philosophy is the quality inspector of thought and the cleanser of ideas; it consistently attempts to take the questions that trouble our minds as problems and subject them to careful and rigorous critique.
Our inner strength and fragility have become more unified than ever before.
Life is a lush valley, a rough terrain — not a checklist of smooth satisfaction, not an abstract map of a successful life.
The Way is not walked alone — perhaps this is what it means!

relatedArticles.title: Tens of Thousands for a Shot: The Gray Business of "Anti-Aging Injections"
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article investigates how, after the implementation of the State Council's Order No. 818, the gray market for stem cell anti-aging treatments has shifted from public to covert operations, with soaring prices and unmet demand, revealing its weak scientific basis and high safety risks.

relatedArticles.title: The Clash of the 'Modern Trojan Horse' Has Arrived
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article provides a detailed review of Ukraine's 'Operation Spider's Web,' which used 117 low-cost FPV drones to infiltrate Russian territory and strike strategic bomber bases, analyzing its tech stack, cost-exchange ratio, strategic deterrent effect, and limitations.

relatedArticles.title: 1.3 Million 'Ranchers' Left Broke
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This in-depth investigation exposes the 'Quanmin Yangniu' platform as a 560 million yuan cloud livestock Ponzi scheme disguised as agricultural investment, revealing how it targeted young middle-class investors, disguised itself as real business operations, and analyzing the court ruling and regulatory crackdown.

relatedArticles.title: S9E3 Luyu in Conversation with Cai Gao | I Am Just a Commoner, Planting Flowers, Planting Grass, Planting Spring
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Luyu and picture book artist Cai Gao explore how, within the constraints of the times and personal hardships, one can exercise the powerful agency of 'I like it, I choose it' through a love for art and life, ultimately living a resilient life like a flower blooming in rock.

relatedArticles.title: 101 A Complaint-Free World | People Addicted to Complaining Have Already Written a Script of Failure for Themselves
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: An in-depth analysis of the book "The Complaint-Free World". The two hosts use personal anecdotes and psychological insights to reveal how complaining becomes addictive and turns people into "victims", and share actionable guidance to quit hidden complaining and reshape life from a builder's perspective.

relatedArticles.title: 14. Jane Eyre: How Far Must a Woman Who Is Neither Beautiful, Rich, Nor Lovable Go to Be Seen?
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Jiang Fangzhou provides a deep analysis of 'Jane Eyre' and the legendary life of its author, Charlotte Brontë, exploring how women can reclaim their sense of self through reflection and independence, moving from 'invisibility' to being 'seen.'

relatedArticles.title: "Pessimists Are Right, Optimists Succeed": Chatting with Friend Yating about the AI Industry
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Veteran investor Zhuang Minghao starts from the fundamental logic of VC, deeply deconstructing the startup paradigms under the AI wave, the endgame of model competition, and the ultimate questioning of human career and existential value.

relatedArticles.title: 13-Year-Old Disabled Girl Jumps to Her Death After Repeatedly Seeking Help from School Counselor
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article provides an in-depth report on the tragedy of a 13-year-old disabled girl who jumped to her death due to school bullying and a lack of psychological support, revealing the practical difficulties of implementing inclusive education and the systemic shortcomings of mental health mechanisms in primary and secondary schools.

relatedArticles.title: 'Post-85s' Founder Puts Up 20 Billion Yuan
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: The article reports details of DeepSeek's first external financing of 50 billion yuan, explains the special equity structure designed by Liang Wenfeng (funds flow into a limited partnership, investors have no voting rights and a five-year lock-up), and analyzes its strategic intent and impact on China's AI self-reliance path.

relatedArticles.title: Vol.83 The Gourmand and the 'Cocoon'
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Starting from Suzhou's Pingtan storytelling and local cuisine, Xu Zhiyuan shares his personal shift from obsessively searching for life's meaning to embracing life's interestingness, and explores how OWSPACE bookstore is localizing and integrating with Suzhou's culture in a new journey.
